func step1(value: Int) :> Int
  value + 1
end

func step2(value: Int) :> Int
  value + 2
end

func step3(value: Int) :> Int
  value + 3
end

func step4(value: Int) :> Int
  value + 4
end

func main() :> Int
  let total1 = step1(0)
  let total2 = step2(total1)
  let total3 = step3(total2)
  let total4 = step4(total3)
  total4
end
